note: Private RV resort on Lake Freeman (Monticello), 1,500 ft of frontage. Lower Village sits behind the beach and piers; Upper Village is inland. The operator says both bathhouses are in rough shape. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50-70. Added 119 sites, 60 ft, 50A/water/sewer, facilities, booking. Note cleaned.
flags: GATE: Upper Village $50 weekdays is at the US$50 line, not over; weekends $60, holidays $65. No gateway (Indiana Dunes NP 109 km). Google 4.5 from 179 reviews. Good Sam directory has no listing, status unknown. Review [Edited 6 months ago]: 'Full hook up sites!! Restaurant isn't open just yet... Bath House is functional, but only has cold water. Even better though...WIFI!!'

RIG RULE: policies say 'in the future White Oaks on the Lake will be restricted to Class A Motor coaches, Class C Motor coaches with a minimum length of 32′ and must be no older than 20 years at time of arrival for the Lower Village'. Today Class A, B, C, teardrop and travel trailers are allowed there; Upper also pop-ups. If it takes effect a 23-ft EKKO loses the Lower Village; the Upper Village stays.

WATER: stored 'not waterfront'; operator says Lower Village has 'great views of the lake'. On imagery the Lower Village loop is about 55 m back from the shore at its south row, with a beach building and day beach between, and houses to the west. Upper Village (the pin) is inland. Possibly 'lakeview' for the south row; lead for the gate. Not changed.
PIN: stored 40.6843,-86.7482 is the Upper Village, inland. Lower Village is about 40.6817,-86.7539, about 550 m off. Both are real sites; pin fine for the cheaper sites.
PHONE: 765-491-8976 confirmed; the site also lists 574-965-4050. Address: GPS 9111 N Key Dr.
SEASON: no page states open dates. Left empty.
SEASONAL SHARE: Upper Village mixes seasonal with nightly, Lower Village 'Seasonal Not Available'; 43 Lower sites daily/weekly/monthly only, so test 4 passes.
